discussion: I've analyzed the two bugs in verifiers.py. The _safe_relative_path has an operator precedence issue: `path.is_absolute() and ".." in path.parts or not path.parts` is parsed as `(absolute AND has_dots) OR (empty)`, so plain absolute paths and relative parent traversal slip through. The _bounded_timeout uses `max(1, max(timeout, MAX))` which always returns >= MAX (60), instead of clamping to [1, MAX]. I need to read 7 more files for the prerequisite coverage before I can make my first edit.
